13 In a shared viewing room, Matthew and Reid jointly observed the paintbrush move from the blue_canvas_bag to the metal_trunk, with the full observer list visible to everyone there.
14 With every viewing device switched off, an automated system moved the paintbrush from the metal_trunk to the green_toolbox; nobody received information about this move.
